channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Safe Kids Treasure Coast offering free pool alarms to Martin County residents
item.description: The Florida Department of Health and Safe Kids Treasure Coast are providing a limited supply of free pool alarms to qualifying Martin County residents with residential pools.

item.title: Two men killed in early morning shooting in Port St. Lucie neighborhood
item.description: Port St. Lucie Police Department is investigating a double fatal shooting that occurred early Sunday morning in a residential neighborhood. item.title: St. Lucie County residents adjust diets as E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks spread
item.description: Health officials confirmed five local cases of cyclospora since May, including two in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County, prompting residents to change what they eat and avoid.

item.title: Spain defeats Argentina 1-0 to win 2026 World Cup in extra time thriller
item.description: Spain defeated Argentina 1-0 on Sunday to win the 2026 FIFA World Cup championship. Ferran Torres scored the winning goal in the 106th minute of extra time, burying a left-footed shot just under the crossbar after pouncing on a bouncing ball in the box. item.title: Major League Baseball restricts dugout iPad use to prevent AI from making decisions
item.description: MLB made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday to stop artificial intelligence from being used for in-game decisions traditionally made by players and coaches.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record with 3:42.66 run in London
item.description: Josh Kerr shattered a 27-year-old world record on Saturday, running the mile in 3:42.66 at a Diamond League event in London.

item.title: World Cup final security includes Secret Service perimeter with President Trump attending
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement and private companies continue security preparations for Sunday's Argentina-Spain World Cup final in New Jersey, with a Secret Service perimeter in place for President Trump's attendance.

item.title: Messi bathed Yamal as baby in 2007 photo shoot, now they meet in World Cup final
item.description: A 2007 charity calendar photo shoot paired teenage Lionel Messi with infant Lamine Yamal. Now 19 years later, they face off in Sunday's World Cup final.

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program Offers Summer Service Projects for South Florida Families
item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation's TLC Program connects volunteers with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained, more expected this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike, both now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: Unity in the Community event connects Fort Pierce families with police and services
item.description: The annual Fort Pierce event brought together families with public safety demonstrations and community resources.
